selector.rationale: The presence of a firm, ulcerated nodule at the umbilicus with adenocarcinoma on biopsy, along with a mass in the right hypochondrium and irregular thickening of the right third of the transverse colon, supports Sister Mary Joseph nodule as the primary diagnosis, which is a metastatic lesion from a primary cancer, in this case, likely from the transverse colon cancer.

rejected.label: Colorectal cancer
rejected.why: While colorectal cancer is a broader category that includes transverse colon cancer, the specific findings point more directly to transverse colon cancer as the primary source, making colorectal cancer less specific in this context.
